product_metadata.title: Christmas Garland, Artificial Holiday PE Mixed Garland with Battery Operated 50 LED Lights, Xmas Decoration Flocked Garland with Pine Cones and Timer for Walls Stairs Fireplaces,9Ft Pre-Lit,Red
features: 【Christmas Garland with Lights Decorations】 9 ft (105") with 10" diameter, 250 branch tips, The vibrant colors combine with traditional patterns which bring easy eye touch.the pine towers are all natural, each shape is different, and they look very realistic. It is a nice decoration for your holiday.

【Battery Operated Christmas Garland with Lights】Pre lit 50 LED lights with Timer that light up the wreath in the dark, 8 Mode of Timer 8 Hours Always On/Flash/Off, Needs 3 AA Batteries (not included).The cane is decorated with golden Christmas leaves; the whole cane is fuller with the abundant red berry strings and natural pine cones.
【Christmas Decoration Garland】This Garland is large and can be used in a variety of places indoor and outdoor, such as the stair case, the mantelpiece or even on door and window frames.

【Full and dense appearance】PVC tip 6cm 0.1 +0.1mm (175 leaves) 3/4 of the PVC tip rolled white (50 leaves) 10cm stained with white pine needles 25 leaves (bagging, length 14+5) Accessories: Seven-headed red fruit *18+6cm dipped White round pine cones*18+ golden sticky powder big leaves*6

【Maintance Notice】 The product in the transport process may be flattened . Once out of the box, all you have to do is shape it and fluff the needles to give it the width and look you desire.The design of manual binding structure, each one is fixed by machine and manual winding, the whole is more upright, the middle is rust-proof galvanized iron wire, you can bend it into any shape you want
